name: Lumbridge
description: Lumbridge Castle courtyard, where new players start and where you respawn after dying. The bank is at the top of the castle.

name: Varrock
description: Varrock's central square by the fountain. Aubury's rune shop, Zaff's staves and both Varrock banks are a short walk away.

name: Grand Exchange
description: The Grand Exchange in north-west Varrock: buy and sell items with every player in the world. Bankers and clerks wait inside.

name: Falador
description: Falador's town square, home of the White Knights. Two banks, the Party Room, Falador Park and the Dwarven Mine are close by.

name: Edgeville
description: Edgeville bank, beside the Wilderness ditch. The Edgeville Dungeon trapdoor and Vannaka's Slayer spot are nearby.

name: Draynor Village
description: Draynor Village: bank, market stalls and the Wise Old Man. Willow trees line the river, and Draynor Manor lies to the north.

name: Al Kharid
description: Al Kharid, the desert town east of Lumbridge: bank, furnace and the palace. Emir's Arena and the Shantay Pass are nearby.

name: Port Sarim
description: Port Sarim docks: boats to Karamja and Entrana, plus fishing and magic shops. Rimmington is just to the west.

name: Rimmington
description: Rimmington, a small village west of Port Sarim with the player-owned house portal and a mine to the north.

name: Camelot
description: Outside Camelot Castle, home of King Arthur and his knights. Seers' Village is to the west.

name: Seers' Village
description: Seers' Village bank, with flax fields, maple and yew trees nearby. The Seers' rooftop course starts at the bank.

name: Catherby
description: Catherby: lobster, swordfish and shark spots on the beach, a herb and allotment patch, and Arhein's general store.

name: East Ardougne
description: East Ardougne market square: baker's, silk, fur, gem and spice stalls for thieving. Bank and Ardougne Castle nearby.

name: West Ardougne
description: West Ardougne, the quarantined half of the city from Plague City and Biohazard.

name: Yanille
description: Yanille, the walled town in south Kandarin: bank, the Wizards' Guild (66 Magic) and the Watchtower to the north.

name: Taverley
description: Taverley, the druids' village north-west of Falador. Taverley Dungeon's entrance and the druids' stone circle are close by.

name: Burthorpe
description: Burthorpe, at the foot of Death Plateau: the Games Room, Turael's Slayer house and the Warriors' Guild.

name: Trollheim
description: The top of Trollheim (Eadgar's Ruse). The path north-east leads to the God Wars Dungeon entrance.

name: Brimhaven
description: Brimhaven on Karamja: dock to Ardougne, the Brimhaven Agility Arena, and Brimhaven Dungeon (Saniboch charges 875 coins).

name: Musa Point
description: Musa Point on Karamja: Luthas's banana plantation, the dock to Port Sarim and the Karamja volcano.

name: Shilo Village
description: Shilo Village in south Karamja (Shilo Village quest): bank, gem mine, fly fishing on the river and Duradel.

name: Tree Gnome Stronghold
description: The Tree Gnome Stronghold: the Grand Tree, gnome gliders, the Gnome Stronghold Agility Course and Nieve.

name: Lletya
description: Lletya, the hidden elven settlement in Tirannwn (Mourning's End Part I), with a bank and shops.

name: Prifddinas
description: Prifddinas, the crystal city of the elves (Song of the Elves): eight clan districts, Zalcano, the Gauntlet and a rooftop course.

name: Zanaris
description: Zanaris, the fairy city (Lost City): the fairy ring hub, the Cosmic Altar and Chaeldar's Slayer spot.

name: Rellekka
description: Rellekka, the Fremennik town: boats to Miscellania, Neitiznot, Jatizso and Waterbirth Island, and a rooftop course.

name: Neitiznot
description: Neitiznot, a Fremennik isle (The Fremennik Isles): yak hide armour, and the helm of neitiznot from Mawnis.

name: Miscellania
description: Miscellania (Throne of Miscellania): keep the kingdom happy and it gathers resources for you. Etceteria is next door.

name: Lunar Isle
description: Lunar Isle, home of the Moonclan (Lunar Diplomacy): the Astral Altar and the Lunar spellbook.

name: Canifis
description: Canifis, the werewolf village in Morytania (Priest in Peril): bank, Mazchna's Slayer spot and the Canifis rooftop course.

name: Port Phasmatys
description: Port Phasmatys, the ghost town (Ghosts Ahoy): the Ectofuntus for Prayer training, a bank and the harbour.

name: Mos Le'Harmless
description: Mos Le'Harmless, the pirate island (Cabin Fever). Cave horrors (58 Slayer) live in the caves.

name: Pollnivneach
description: Pollnivneach, the desert town south of the Shantay Pass: the Pollnivneach rooftop course and the Smoke Dungeon well.

name: Nardah
description: Nardah, the desert town by the River Elid: bank, the shrine of Elidinis, and Zahur, who cleans herbs.

name: Sophanem
description: Sophanem, the desert city of Icthlarin (Icthlarin's Little Helper): bank and Pyramid Plunder.

name: Kourend Castle
description: Kourend Castle, at the centre of Great Kourend. Every house of Kourend is a short walk away.

name: Hosidius
description: Hosidius, Kourend's farming house: farming patches, the Tithe Farm, the clay oven kitchen and the vinery.

name: Arceuus
description: Arceuus, Kourend's house of magic: the Arceuus Library, the Dark Altar and the Arceuus spellbook from Tyss.

name: Lovakengj
description: Lovakengj, Kourend's house of mining and smithing: the Lovakite mine and the blast mine.

name: Port Piscarilius
description: Port Piscarilius, Kourend's fishing house: anglerfish, the boat to Tempoross Cove and the port market.

name: Shayzien
description: Shayzien, Kourend's military house: the combat ring, Shayzien armour and the crypts.

name: Civitas illa Fortis
description: Civitas illa Fortis, the capital of Varlamore: banks, the Fortis Colosseum and the quetzal transport network.

name: Ferox Enclave
description: Ferox Enclave, a safe haven inside the Wilderness: no player combat, a bank, and the Pool of Refreshment.

name: Ape Atoll
description: Ape Atoll, home of the monkeys of Marim (Monkey Madness I): the Ape Atoll Agility Course.

name: Chambers of Xeric
description: Chambers of Xeric, beneath Mount Quidamortem: a raid for 1 to 100 players ending with the Great Olm. Challenge Mode too.

name: Theatre of Blood
description: Theatre of Blood in Ver Sinhaza, Morytania: six rooms for 1 to 5 players, ending with Verzik Vitur. Entry and Hard Mode.

name: Tombs of Amascut
description: Tombs of Amascut, in the Necropolis: pick invocations to set the raid level, 1 to 8 players, ending with the Wardens.

name: The Fractured Archive
description: The Fractured Archive, beneath the Tears of Guthix cave (While Guthix Sleeps): five bosses for 1 to 8 players, ending with Ocellus.

name: God Wars Dungeon
description: The God Wars Dungeon: Graardor, Zilyana, K'ril and Kree'arra, each behind a kill count. Nex waits beyond the frozen door.

name: Zulrah
description: Zul-Andra (Regicide): take the boat from the jetty to Zulrah, the solo snake boss that changes form and style.

name: Vorkath
description: Ungael, Vorkath's island (Dragon Slayer II). An undead dragon: bring anti-dragon protection and venom cures.

name: Corporeal Beast
description: The Corporeal Beast's cave: a 2,000 Hitpoint group boss that takes reduced damage from everything but spears and halberds.

name: Kraken
description: Kraken Cove: the Kraken boss (87 Slayer, kraken task). Disturb the whirlpools to bring it up.

name: Cerberus
description: Cerberus' lair in Taverley Dungeon: the hellhound boss (91 Slayer, hellhound task).

name: Thermonuclear smoke devil
description: The Smoke Devil Dungeon: the Thermonuclear smoke devil (93 Slayer, smoke devil task). Wear a face mask or slayer helmet.

name: Abyssal Sire
description: The Abyssal Nexus: the Abyssal Sire (85 Slayer, abyssal demon task).

name: Alchemical Hydra
description: The Karuulm Slayer Dungeon: the Alchemical Hydra (95 Slayer, hydra task). Boots of stone or better are needed inside.

name: Giant Mole
description: Falador Park: dig into a mole hill with a spade to fall into the Giant Mole's tunnels.

name: Kalphite Queen
description: The Kalphite Lair in the Kharidian Desert: the Kalphite Queen, whose two forms resist different styles. Bring ropes.

name: Dagannoth Kings
description: Waterbirth Island: the three Dagannoth Kings below, Rex, Prime and Supreme, each weak to a different style.

name: Sarachnis
description: Forthos Dungeon, south of Hosidius: Sarachnis, the spider queen.

name: The Nightmare
description: Slepe, Morytania: the Nightmare of Ashihama beneath the Sisterhood Sanctuary. Phosani's Nightmare is the solo version.

name: The Leviathan
description: The Scar (Desert Treasure II): the Leviathan.

name: The Whisperer
description: The Lassar Undercity (Desert Treasure II): the Whisperer.

name: Vardorvis
description: The Stranglewood (Desert Treasure II): Vardorvis.

name: Duke Sucellus
description: Ghorrock Dungeon (Desert Treasure II): Duke Sucellus.

name: Scurrius
description: The Varrock Sewers: Scurrius, the rat king, a mid-level boss for solo players or groups.

name: Perilous Moons
description: Neypotzli, Varlamore: the Perilous Moons, three boss fights with supplies gathered at the camp.

name: Araxxor
description: The Morytania Spider Nest: Araxxor (92 Slayer, spider or araxyte task).

name: The Hueycoatl
description: Varlamore: the Hueycoatl, a group boss.

name: Amoxliatl
description: The Ruins of Tapoyauik, Varlamore: Amoxliatl.

name: The Royal Titans
description: The Asgarnian Ice Dungeon: the Royal Titans, Branda the Fire Queen and Eldric the Ice King.

name: Barrows
description: The Barrows: dig into each mound, defeat the six brothers in their crypts, then loot the chest in the tunnels.

name: Zalcano
description: Prifddinas: Zalcano, a skilling boss damaged by mining, refining and imbuing tephra.

name: The Gauntlet
description: Prifddinas: the Gauntlet. Gather and craft gear in a random dungeon, then face the Crystalline Hunllef. Corrupted version too.

name: TzHaar Fight Cave
description: The TzHaar Fight Cave: 63 waves ending with TzTok-Jad, for the fire cape.

name: The Inferno
description: The Inferno in Mor Ul Rek: 69 waves ending with TzKal-Zuk. Sacrifice a fire cape to enter.

name: Tormented Demons
description: The Ancient Guthixian Temple (While Guthix Sleeps): Tormented Demons, who drop claws and synapses.

name: Callisto
description: The entrance to Callisto's Den. Callisto is a great bear in multi-combat.

name: Vet'ion
description: The entrance to Vet'ion's Rest. Vet'ion is a skeleton champion in multi-combat.

name: Venenatis
description: The entrance to the Silk Chasm. Venenatis is a giant spider in multi-combat.

name: Artio
description: The entrance to Hunter's End: Artio, the single-combat version of Callisto.

name: Calvar'ion
description: The entrance to the Skeletal Tomb: Calvar'ion, the single-combat version of Vet'ion.

name: Spindel
description: The entrance to the Web Chasm: Spindel, the single-combat version of Venenatis.

name: Chaos Elemental
description: Rogues' Castle: the Chaos Elemental, which can teleport you and unequip your items.

name: Scorpia
description: The Scorpion Pit: Scorpia, the scorpion queen, and her guardians.

name: King Black Dragon
description: The King Black Dragon's lair, a three-headed dragon. Bring anti-dragon protection.

name: Revenant Caves
description: The Revenant Caves: revenants drop ancient artefacts, ether and wilderness weapons. Multi-combat.

name: Woodcutting Guild
description: Woodcutting Guild, Hosidius (60 Woodcutting): redwoods, magic, yew and maple trees, with a boost while inside.

name: Mining Guild
description: Mining Guild under Falador (60 Mining): coal, mithril, adamantite, runite and amethyst.

name: Motherlode Mine
description: Motherlode Mine in the Dwarven Mine (30 Mining): mine pay-dirt, wash it, and collect ores and golden nuggets.

name: Fishing Guild
description: Fishing Guild (68 Fishing): lobsters, swordfish, tuna and sharks, with a bank right beside the docks.

name: Piscatoris Fishing Colony
description: Piscatoris Fishing Colony (Swan Song): monkfish, with a bank close by.

name: Farming Guild
description: Farming Guild (45 Farming): Farming contracts, and the redwood, celastrus, spirit tree and anima patches.

name: Tithe Farm
description: The Tithe Farm, Hosidius (34 Farming): grow and water seeds for Farming experience and points.

name: Crafting Guild
description: Crafting Guild (40 Crafting): pottery, spinning, a gold and clay mine, and a bank.

name: Cooking Guild
description: Cooking Guild (32 Cooking, chef's hat): ranges, a dairy churn and cooking supplies.

name: Hosidius Kitchen
description: Hosidius Kitchen: the clay oven range, which burns less food than an ordinary range.

name: Blast Furnace
description: Blast Furnace (Keldagrim): smelt bars with half the usual coal. Pay the foreman below 60 Smithing.

name: Gnome Stronghold Agility
description: Gnome Stronghold Agility Course: the first course, from level 1 Agility.

name: Canifis Rooftop
description: Canifis rooftop course (40 Agility), with marks of grace.
source: content/skills/src/main/kotlin/tp/content/skills/AgilityRooftops.kt:38 (the last obstacle's landing, by the course start)

name: Falador Rooftop
description: Falador rooftop course (50 Agility), with marks of grace.
source: content/skills/src/main/kotlin/tp/content/skills/AgilityRooftops.kt:74 (the last obstacle's landing, by the course start)

name: Seers' Village Rooftop
description: Seers' Village rooftop course (60 Agility), with marks of grace.
source: content/skills/src/main/kotlin/tp/content/skills/AgilityRooftops.kt:100 (the last obstacle's landing, by the course start)

name: Pollnivneach Rooftop
description: Pollnivneach rooftop course (70 Agility), with marks of grace.
source: content/skills/src/main/kotlin/tp/content/skills/AgilityRooftops.kt:129 (the last obstacle's landing, by the course start)

name: Rellekka Rooftop
description: Rellekka rooftop course (80 Agility), with marks of grace.
source: content/skills/src/main/kotlin/tp/content/skills/AgilityRooftops.kt:156 (the last obstacle's landing, by the course start)

name: Ardougne Rooftop
description: Ardougne rooftop course (90 Agility), with marks of grace.
source: content/skills/src/main/kotlin/tp/content/skills/AgilityRooftops.kt:186 (the last obstacle's landing, by the course start)

name: Prifddinas Agility
description: Prifddinas Agility Course (75 Agility): crystal shards and portals for bonus experience.

name: Hallowed Sepulchre
description: Hallowed Sepulchre, Darkmeyer (52 Agility, Sins of the Father): five floors of traps, coffins and the Grand Hallowed Coffin.

name: Wintertodt
description: Wintertodt, north of Kourend (50 Firemaking): keep the braziers burning to subdue the Wintertodt.

name: Tempoross
description: Tempoross Cove (35 Fishing): fish, cook and fight the storm spirit Tempoross with other players.

name: Guardians of the Rift
description: Guardians of the Rift, beneath the Temple of the Eye (27 Runecraft): power the Great Guardian with runes.

name: Ourania Altar
description: The Ourania cave: the ZMI altar crafts random runes from pure essence.

name: Blood Altar
description: Blood Altar, north-east Kourend (77 Runecraft): blood runes from dark essence fragments.

name: Soul Altar
description: Soul Altar, north of Kourend (90 Runecraft): soul runes from dark essence fragments.

name: Abyss (Mage of Zamorak)
description: The Mage of Zamorak, who teleports you into the Abyss to reach every runecrafting altar.

name: Volcanic Mine
description: Volcanic Mine, Fossil Island (50 Mining): mine the volcano with a team while keeping its vents in check.

name: Pyramid Plunder
description: Pyramid Plunder, Sophanem (21 Thieving): loot urns, chests and sarcophagi in the pyramid's rooms.

name: Rogues' Den
description: Rogues' Den, under the Burthorpe pub: the safe-cracking room and the Rogues' Den maze (50 Thieving and Agility).

name: Sorceress's Garden
description: Sorceress's Garden, Al Kharid: sneak past the elementals and pick fruit in the four seasonal gardens.

name: Hunter Guild
description: Hunter Guild, Varlamore (46 Hunter): Hunter rumours from the guild masters.

name: Feldip Hunter Area
description: Feldip Hunter area: red chinchompas, birds and Feldip weasels.

name: Chaos Altar
description: The Chaos Temple in the Wilderness: offering bones on its altar can save them and gives extra Prayer experience.

name: Barbarian Outpost
description: Barbarian Outpost: barbarian training, and the Barbarian Assault minigame.

name: Emir's Arena
description: Emir's Arena, Al Kharid: ranked and unranked player-versus-player fights.

name: Castle Wars
description: Castle Wars: Saradomin against Zamorak, capture the other team's flag.

name: Soul Wars
description: Soul Wars, Isle of Souls: two teams fight for the soul obelisk and the Avatar.

name: Pest Control
description: Pest Control, the Void Knights' Outpost: defend the knight and destroy the portals for commendation points and Void Knight equipment.

name: Barbarian Assault
description: Barbarian Assault: a team of five against the Penance, with roles for attacker, defender, collector and healer.

name: Fortis Colosseum
description: Fortis Colosseum, Civitas illa Fortis: twelve waves of combat challenges ending with Sol Heredit.

name: Warriors' Guild
description: Warriors' Guild, Burthorpe (130 combined Attack and Strength): defenders from the Cyclopes.

name: Champions' Guild
description: Champions' Guild, south of Varrock (32 quest points): the Champion's challenge scrolls.

name: Ranging Guild
description: Ranging Guild, north of East Ardougne (40 Ranged): archery targets and ranged shops.

name: Myths' Guild
description: Myths' Guild, Feldip Hills (Dragon Slayer II): the Mythical cape and Myths' Guild dungeon.

name: Wizards' Tower
description: Wizards' Tower, south of Draynor: Sedridor and the start of Rune Mysteries.

name: Mage Arena
description: The Mage Arena: Kolodion's challenge for the god spells, and the god capes.

name: Tears of Guthix
description: Tears of Guthix, in the Lumbridge Swamp Caves: collect the blue tears each week for experience in your lowest skill.

name: Fossil Island
description: Fossil Island: the museum camp, with the Volcanic Mine, the Wyvern Cave and the House on the Hill nearby.

name: Lighthouse
description: The Lighthouse north of the Barbarian Outpost (Horror from the Deep): dagannoths below.

name: Draynor Manor
description: Draynor Manor, home of Professor Oddenstein and Count Draynor (Ernest the Chicken, Vampyre Slayer).

name: Salve Graveyard
description: Salve Graveyard, Morytania, by the River Salve.

name: Harmony Island
description: Harmony Island, off Mos Le'Harmless (The Great Brain Robbery): its herb patch is disease-free.

name: Turael (Slayer)
description: Turael in Burthorpe: the easiest Slayer tasks, no requirements.

name: Mazchna (Slayer)
description: Mazchna in Canifis: Slayer tasks for combat level 20 and up.

name: Vannaka (Slayer)
description: Vannaka in Edgeville Dungeon: Slayer tasks for combat level 40 and up.

name: Chaeldar (Slayer)
description: Chaeldar in Zanaris: Slayer tasks for combat level 70 and up (Lost City).

name: Nieve (Slayer)
description: Nieve in the Tree Gnome Stronghold: Slayer tasks for combat level 85 and up.

name: Duradel (Slayer)
description: Duradel in Shilo Village: Slayer tasks for combat level 100 and up, 50 Slayer.

name: Konar (Slayer)
description: Konar quo Maten on Mount Karuulm: Slayer tasks for combat level 75 and up, with a set location for each task.

name: Krystilia (Slayer)
description: Krystilia in Edgeville: Wilderness Slayer tasks, with no requirements.
